## Why
Operator direction (2026-08-15): approach viral-peppy-lowchen (b4be-0ed8-22cb-4b01) as an EXPERIMENT before any production design. Experience says a pure evidence-prepacked single-pass verifier yields false-positive REJECTIONS whenever the prepack is imperfect — and a perfect prepack over natural-language prose ACs is unrealistic. Operator counter-proposal to test: use the single pass as a FILTER that may only PASS or ABSTAIN per criterion (never reject), then run the existing agentic verifier scoped to the remaining criteria — narrowing agentic work, not eliminating it. Structural consequence: false-positive rejection is impossible by construction; the residual risks to MEASURE are false-positive PASSes and insufficient coverage (filter abstains so often it saves nothing).

## Protocol (rapid PoC — throwaway harness, no production code)
1. Corpus: select >=3 real CLOSED tickets with large surfaces (description near the 8000-char cap, >=6 prose ACs, comments; at least one with children), e.g. the tapeworm CLI-normalization ticket (7998 chars) and the bettong decomposition ticket. Ground truth for these = all ACs met (they passed the close gate). Add >=3 ADVERSARIAL variants: copies (in-harness, not written to the store) with 1-2 ACs edited to be genuinely unmet (reference a symbol/behavior that does not exist at the verified ref). Ground truth = those ACs unmet.
2. Prepack builder (harness script): per AC, deterministically assemble evidence — file_impact paths + their content slices, grep hits for symbols/strings the AC names, referencing commits + diffs, test names/results where cited. Cap per-AC pack size; record pack-build failures honestly (missing evidence -> thin pack, NOT a synthesized one).
3. Filter pass: ONE LLM call, no tools: given ticket text + per-AC packs, emit per AC either PASS(with citations) or ABSTAIN. The contract forbids FAIL.
4. Fallback: run the existing agentic verifier scoped to the ABSTAINed ACs via the ticket-load seam: `verify_completion` loads the root ticket through `_reads.show_ticket` (src/rebar/llm/completion.py:197); the harness monkeypatches that read (the standard unit-suite technique) to return the real ticket with its Acceptance Criteria block REDUCED to the abstained ACs. Criteria enumeration (`explicit_completion_criteria`, completion_criteria.py:45) and the step floor (completion.py:212-237, keyed on checkbox count) both derive from that text, so the budget narrows automatically — that IS the mechanism under test. Read-only --source local, never signs.
4b. Comparability: the pure-agentic control runs the SAME harness (same monkeypatch machinery, un-reduced ticket, same ref, same config) so fixed overheads cancel; the cost delta is reported as (filter LLM call + narrowed agentic run) vs (full agentic run), each with its own auto-derived floor. Child-closure/precheck asymmetries are avoided by corpus selection: childless tickets verify identically in both arms; the one with-children ticket is reported separately with this caveat stated.
5. Metrics table (the deliverable): filter coverage (%% ACs PASSed at step 3), false-PASS count on adversarial unmet ACs (MUST be 0 for the design to survive), agentic steps/tokens/wall-time for step 4 vs a pure-agentic control run of the same ticket, per-ticket totals.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Harness exists in the experiment worktree (throwaway; NOT pushed to Gerrit; no src/rebar changes).
- [ ] >=3 real large closed tickets + >=3 adversarial variants run end-to-end through filter+fallback AND a pure-agentic control.
- [ ] Metrics table posted as a comment on THIS ticket and on viral-peppy-lowchen: coverage, false-PASS count, cost deltas.
- [ ] Verdict comment: does filter+fallback beat pure-agentic on cost WITHOUT any false PASS? Include failure modes observed and a go/no-go recommendation for productizing.
- [ ] No store writes beyond ticket comments; no signatures minted (--source local only).
